ops.text: tooling.py github-quota refusal is recorded from a read: on 2026-10-01, `gh pr view 236 --json body -q .body` printed #236's PR body, which quotes 'GitHub GraphQL quota exhausted', and record_refusal warned 'ccx refused this action ... github-quota'. The signature fires on any GITHUB_VERBS call (gh pr ...) whose stdout contains the text anywhere, so read verbs that echo prose record false refusals. Fix direction: take quota refusals only from stderr or a failed exit, never from a read's payload.
